article.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing for Cystic Fibrosis

abstract.p: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder caused by mutations in the CFTR gene. The CRISPR-Cas9 system offers a promising avenue for correcting these mutations. In vitro and in vivo studies have demonstrated the potential of this technology. However, challenges related to delivery and off-target effects need to be addressed. This review discusses recent advancements and future prospects. © 2023 Researcher et al.

article.keywords: CRISPR, Gene Editing, Cystic Fibrosis, CFTR
